item.title: Seagaia Resort — Guide
item.description: Seagaia is a large integrated seaside resort on the Pacific coast just north of Miyazaki city, set within a beautiful expanse of coastal pine forest known as Hitotsuba. Making the most of Miyazaki’s warm, sunny, resort-like climate, the complex brings together a range of leisure and relaxation facilities in one place: luxury and family hotels including a landmark tower hotel, championship golf courses, a tennis centre, a soothing hot-spring spa (Matsu no Yu), restaurants and event spaces, all a short distance from the beach.
